articles.title: Varanasi passenger boards overnight train with confirmed berth A1/54, finds no such seat in coach with 52 berths; Railways say software glitch led to wrong allotment
articles.summary: VARANASI: A passenger travelling on a confirmed ticket aboard a North Eastern Railway (NER) train found that his allotted berth did not exist in the
articles.body: VARANASI: A passenger travelling on a confirmed ticket aboard a North Eastern Railway (NER) train found that his allotted berth did not exist in the coach, prompting the Railways to acknowledge a software glitch that led to the discrepancy.Ishan Bajpai was travelling on Train No. 15132 from Varanasi City to Gorakhpur Junction on November 22 when he discovered that his confirmed berth, A1/54, was missing. The AC 2-tier coach had only 52 berths, leaving him without an allotted seat despite holding a confirmed ticket.Bajpai flagged the issue on X around 10.45pm, expressing frustration over being left without a berth during an overnight journey. He also said he had registered a complaint through railway helpline 139.Responding to his post, the Railways' official grievance redressal handle said the matter had been escalated to the concerned official. It also sought his mobile number through a direct message to facilitate immediate action and advised him to use the RailMadad portal or helpline 139.A North Eastern Railway spokesperson from the Varanasi division said the department immediately responded to the passenger's post on X, regretting the inconvenience caused to him and another passenger."Both were accommodated on other berths in the same train.
